title: SimpleQoL
description: One mod that adds multiple, configurable, quality of life features such as Zoom, Freelook, Borderless Fullscreen, Full bright, and Custom Crosshairs!
body:
# SimpleQoL

**One mod. Six features. Zero bloat.**

SimpleQoL bundles the quality-of-life features you'd normally need five separate mods for — all in one lightweight client-side package with a clean in-game config screen.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🔍 Zoom
Hold **C** to zoom in, just like OptiFine.
- Scroll wheel adjusts zoom level while held
- Smooth FOV interpolation in and out
- Optional smooth camera mode while zooming
- Hides your hand while zoomed for a cleaner view
- Fully configurable: divisor, scroll toggle, smooth camera toggle

### 🌟 Fullbright
Press **B** to toggle maximum brightness instantly.
- Saves your previous gamma setting and restores it on disable
- Never writes the high gamma value to `options.txt` — your settings stay clean
- One keypress on, one keypress off

### 🖥️ Borderless Fullscreen
Press **F11** to toggle true borderless windowed mode.
- Uses GLFW directly — no hacks, no flicker
- Saves and restores your previous window position and size
- Alt-tab friendly

### 👁️ Freelook
Hold **V** to look around freely without rotating your player body.
- Camera snaps back to your movement direction when released
- Great for scouting, building, and parkour

### 📍 Coordinates HUD
A clean, always-visible overlay showing where you are.
- Displays XYZ position, facing direction, biome name
- Shows your Nether/Overworld coordinate equivalent automatically
- Choose from 4 screen corners (Top Left, Top Right, Bottom Left, Bottom Right)
- Hides automatically when F3 is open
- Toggle via keybind or config screen

### ➕ Crosshair Customizer
Replace the vanilla crosshair with something that's actually yours.
- **5 styles:** Default, Cross, Dot, Circle, Circle + Dot
- Full RGB color picker with opacity control
- Adjustable size and thickness
- Optional black outline for visibility on any background
- Hide in third person view
- Hide when not targeting a block or entity

---

## ⚙️ Config

All settings are accessible in-game via the **Mod Menu** gear icon — no need to edit any files. Config is saved to `<gamedir>/config/simpleqol.json` and persists across sessions.

Every keybind is rebindable in the standard **Controls** menu.

---

## 📦 Dependencies

| Mod | Required |
|---|---|
| [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) 0.16.14+ | ✅ |
| [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) | ✅ |
| [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) | ✅ |

---
